board: Adafruit ENS160 MOX Gas Sensor breakout (product 5606)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico. The model uses the datasheet register map: PART_ID 0x0160, OPMODE 0x02 gates the data, and AQI, TVOC and eCO2 are little-endian at 0x21-0x25. The driver resets the chip, sets standard mode and waits for NEWDAT; the I2C pins are named SCL/SDA (printed SCK/SDI) because the simulator needs those names.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-ENS160-PCB (board silkscreen x-order: VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCK, SDO, SDI, CS, INT) and https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-ens160-mox-gas-sensor/pinouts
